# Border Beam (vendored source)

Source: https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev/tree/999866f33df216dab0f8956f91c8d2e918d46328/packages/border-beam

Upstream commit: `999866f33df216dab0f8956f91c8d2e918d46328`.
MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Jakub Antalik. See the complete `LICENSE`.

The five source files are unchanged from upstream. Only this package is included;
the Libraries.dev website and other packages are not copied. The upstream source
declares version 1.4.0, which was not available from npm at integration time.

Tongpin uses the light monochrome palette on its warm-white composer. Motion is active only while the
composer has focus or a real request is responding, and is disabled for reduced
motion or hidden documents. An application-scoped CSS override keeps wrapper
overflow visible so attachment and tool menus are not clipped.
